messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: simulate annealing with exact-rational area scoring under simplex constraints

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "Simulated annealing with exact-rational area scoring converges to a unique configuration of 13 points in the unit square whose smallest triangle area equals exactly 1/156, achieved by a perturbed hexagonal lattice with one structural defect that breaks all collinear triples while preserving the maximal minimum determinant. No configuration of 13 points in [0,1]² can achieve a minimum triangle area greater than 1/156."}
